title: satureja varia
intro: Satureja varia, commonly known as the variable savory, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is a herb native to the Mediterranean region, known for its culinary and medicinal uses. The health benefits of Satureja varia include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to protect against infections and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include carvacrol, thymol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-diarrheal, and antifungal properties.
